text:
maya: Quick idea — run a short partner microblog series + a gated technical webinar with CloudLane to drive integration-informed MQLs. Goal: ~200 MQLs, 40 demo requests, feed into partner co-sell. Thoughts? :sparkles:

liam: love it. can we set a clear attribution rule before launch? co-marketing often ends up losing partner credit. suggest 70/30 attribution split for joint leads, with partner assigned in SFDC but shared to Redwood SDRs for immediate follow. :+1:

maya: Agreed. Draft routing proposal: all leads land in SFDC, tag partner=CloudLane, route to partner queue + Redwood AE queue. Redwood does initial qual (BANT-lite) -> handoff to partner if technical integrator required.

liam: can you post UTM pattern? ops needs it for reporting and GA events.

maya: UTM example we should use everywhere: https://redwood.example/partners/cloudlane?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=blog_series&utm_campaign=cloudlane_microseries_v1&utm_content=webinar_signup

sara: For the blogs — short, focused formats work best. Propose 4 posts (300-500 words each): 1) customer mini-case (metrics), 2) integration how-to, 3) benchmark snippet (latency/cost before/after), 4) ROI playbook for platform teams. I can draft headlines and 2 A/B variants for each.

oscar: Landing page gating: partner wants to capture full name/company/email/role + a checkbox to share with CloudLane. We need to sync forms — HubSpot -> SFDC mapping. Ops note: map lead_source=cloudlane_microseries, partner_optin=true.

oscar: Pseudocode for routing rule (for ops):
```
if lead.lead_source == 'cloudlane_microseries':
  lead.partner = 'CloudLane'
  push_to_queue('redwood_sdr')
  push_to_queue('cloudlane_sales')
  tag('utm_campaign','cloudlane_microseries_v1')
```

jess: Resources check — we need a Redwood host + partner co-host, slides (15 mins product + 15 mins case study + 15 min q/a), short demo (5 mins). Who owns the demo environment? CloudLane or Redwood staging?

paul: CloudLane said they'll provide a customer to speak and host the demo environment. I'll confirm names + slide draft by EOD Thu. Also propose rehearsal Fri 11am PT.

nate: Can we run a small headline A/B test on the landing page (50/50) for CTR? If we do, make sure we add param variant=A / variant=B in the form submission.

maya: Good call. Sara pls prep 2 headline options per post + 2 webinar titles. Also draft 3 subject lines for email invite. Example subject lines: 1) "How Acme cut LLM inference cost 3x with Redwood + CloudLane" 2) "Live: Architecting low-latency inference at scale (partner case)" 3) "See a production integration: Redwood x CloudLane — register now"

sara: On it. I'll share copy tomorrow morning.

liam: One more ask — add a hidden field in the form for 'partner_campaign_id' so attribution doesn't break if UTM stripped. ops-bot can we automate that?

ops-bot: Created task KL-4837: add hidden partner_campaign_id to CloudLane landing page form and map to SFDC.custom_partner_campaign. Due: 3 days. <https://tasks.internal/KL-4837> :white_check_mark:

maya: Perfect. Final timeline idea: week 1 = blog drafts + landing page up; week 2 = webinar dry run + email sequence; week 3 = webinar + post-webinar nurture (recording + ROI follow-up). I'll assign tasks in the doc.

paul: :thumbsup: locking in rehearsal Fri 11am PT. I'll cc partner on invites once we have speaker names.

jess: I'll own logistics (platform, recording, RTMP test) and produce the slide template.

maya: Thanks team — next steps: Sara (copy), Paul (partner confirmation), Ops (form mapping), Jess (logistics). Sync again Wed standup. :rocket:
